notes.title: Fixed a couple of bugs!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Thank you all so much for checking out my game! I’ve seen a lot of very nice reviews already and it makes me happy that you seem to be enjoying it! :)

I just uploaded a new build that should fix a couple of issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed a potential run-killer that would appear when you would enter the strange hallway after obtaining the small idol.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would spawn in some sort of empty void after going to bed on Sunday.
[*] Fixed an issue where it would still be raining after starting a new run.
[*] Put back a fence behind the cornfield, I don’t know where it went but it’s back now.
[*] Made sure you are not able to fall off the ferry anymore.
[*] Made sure that the darkness also closes in on you when you enter the strange hallway or hedge maze area, causing players to get lost in darkness forever there.
[*] Implemented a failsafe that should always unlock the content you get when you 100% areas (I believe this worked for most users, but someone in the discussions said they didn’t unlock some of it at 100%).
[*] Fixed a bug where you would be able to get stuck behind the gas station counter on Monday by closing it and not being able to open it anymore.
[*] Fixed an issue with colliders that made interacting with the picnic blanket a bit wonky.
[*] Added an option under AUDIO settings that reduces the volume of loud jumpscare sounds (let me know if this could be reduced further).
[*] Put some extra invisible walls here and there to make sure you all don’t get out of bounds too much haha
[/list]

If you still encounter any of these problems or find new ones, don’t hesitate to let me know and I’ll see what I can do about it!

Thanks again for taking the time to play my game, I hope you have a lovely time doing some normal gardening!

-Tom

notes.title: Grunn is out today!
notes.notes:
Very happy to announce that Grunn is launching today on PC!

This has been a labour of love of mine for almost two years, and I’m very happy and proud to see it going out into the world. The garden and the surrounding town are a recreation of my own father’s house and neighbourhood in the Dutch countryside. I've also had a lot of fun adding secrets, easter eggs and hidden pathways for the curious minded! 

Without giving too much away, I will say that there are multiple ways to finish this game. If you roll credits too early, consider going back and trying again :) 

Thank you so much to everyone who has shown me encouragement and support throughout the development process. I hope you enjoy the game!

Sincerely, 

Tom from Sokpop

notes.title: Not normal at all, don’t let it lie to you gardening game Grunn is out now
notes.notes:
I’m usually a little suspicious of anything that winkingly describes itself as “very normal”. It’s got Mental Baz energy to me. You’ve met mental Baz, right? He’s mental, he is! Has half a lemonade shandy with lunch sometimes, and wears one of those t-shirts that look like a tuxedo. Absolute mentalist! Anyway, after reviewing Grunn last week it’s thankfully far more interesting and creative than poor old Baz, who’s honestly just a bit shy and actually really nice when you get past the facade. Grunn just released today, and my high level tempter is that it’s a little bit like Outer Wilds, just with all the touching wonder replaced by spooky whimsy. Here’s a trailer:

notes.title: We have a release date for Grunn!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Developer Tom here :) And I bring good news!

My game Grunn is launching on PC via Steam on October 4th!! We made the announcement today at the Fantastic Games Fest in Austin. Here is the trailer:

[previewyoutube=ko2IfE7NLvM;full][/previewyoutube]

As a reminder, Grunn is a game about gardening, and it is normal. Trim the grass, water the flowers, pick up trash, and of course enjoy the lovely scenery of the dutch countryside. Maybe you feel like you’re being watched, but that’s probably your imagination, right? Oh and don’t forget to trim the hedges!

Another cool thing: The Grunn demo won the Digital Moment Award at this year’s A MAZE fest! Woah!

Thanks again to everyone who has shown their support for Grunn since the announcement, I am very excited to see you all experiencing the full game in a few weeks!

Happy gardening < : ●)

Tom

notes.title: Small patch: added some new settings!
notes.notes:
A couple people reported that they got dizzy and/or nauseous when playing Grunn, so I added some new settings: 

[list]
[*] [b]Wobbly effect:[/b] Toggles on/off the effect that makes everything slightly move & appear dreamy/wobbly.
[*] [b]Pixel smoothing:[/b] Toggles on/off the fuzzy smoothing effect of pixels.
[*] [b]Pixel scale:[/b] You can increase this to make the game appear less chunky, more smooth.
[*] [b]Font type:[/b] Added 2 new fonts that are hopefully a bit more legible, please feel free to let me know if this helps, I can always add more fonts!
[/list]
You can find all of these new settings in the title screen or when pausing the game, under 'settings'.

Some other things you can try against getting dizzy (also in settings):
[list]
[*] Increase the field of view.
[*] Decrease the color shift value.
[/list]
[b]One other thing:[/b] There were also reports of the game looking incredibly fuzzy and weirdly low-res on ultra wide monitors, and I believe I've also fixed this issue!

Thanks for playing my demo :) Let me know if this helps or if there is anything else I can add that could improve the experience! 

-Tom

notes.title: It's time for some very normal gardening!
notes.notes:
It's time to start gardening! Let's cut some grass, trim some hedges, water some flowers... and look for a worm?

[b]A free demo of Grunn is playable here:[/b] http://s.team/a/2720950 

Grunn is a very normal gardening game. You’ve been hired to work on a garden deep in the Dutch countryside. There’s plenty to do: trim the grass, water the flowers, pick up trash, and of course enjoy the lovely scenery. 

Except… Most of your tools are missing. The owner isn’t around. Going out after dark is forbidden. And no matter where you go, you can't escape the sense you're being watched.

You have until Monday to complete the job. Good luck!

notes.title: Deeply unusual gardening game Grunn’s shear snip deserves every award Geoff Keighley has ever invented
notes.notes:
I usually avoid writing sentences that could easily be quoted on a Steam page, but the exquisitely satisfying sound that Grunn’s garden shears make is the exception. Please feel free to try any of these on for size: Grunn’s shear sound is the Wilhelm Scream of gardening equipment, sure to be referenced for decades to come. Grunn’s shear sound wormed its way past my eyes and into parts of my brain I’d previously assumed could only be accessed by either masterful ASMR or irresponsibly long Q-tips. I used to have anxiety, but now, my only fear in life is that Grunn’s grass will run out, so I no longer have a reason to click away with its shears. Play Grunn, innit. There are, by the way, lots of other things to like about it, although I cannot hear them over the wonderful sound of these shears.
